verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents a sandboxed Bash tool providing filesystem and network isolation, letting users define which files/domains commands can touch, enforced by the OS — this supports running agent actions in an isolated sandbox rather than freely touching arbitrary data. However, there is no explicit documentation tying this to a 'test vs production data' workflow or dedicated staging environment concept, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the isolation working as claimed. Missing for 10: explicit production-data protection guidance, staging/test-environment integration, independent verification of sandbox isolation.
